rationale: We eliminate the -$9,500 cash deficit by avoiding the idle-land capital starvation of Gens 90-92 through a phased Day 3-5 transition (sowing hyper-fertilized Strawberries on all affordable plots on Day 3 morning, using quick Carrot filler on remaining plots, and converting 100% of acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries on Day 5). We eradicate post-harvest regrowth stalls and mid-field travel waste by synchronizing watering can refills at the well immediately following shed drop-offs (introducing an 11:00-12:00 midday drop window), ensuring hands depart the farm center with 100% full cans to execute same-tick in-situ watering without detour delays. Finally, we front-load contiguous land expansion to 20-24 plots and 10-11 hands by Day 11 with a hard freeze at Day 11 (yielding 8-10 recurring flushes across all acreage), defend mature liquidation floors at >= 0.85x base price, and ban Carrot re-seeding after Day 10 to keep 100% of mature Strawberry acreage compounding through Day 30.
